title: obstacle-aware-coverage: Fields2Cover extensions, benchmark and data for obstacle-aware coverage paths and controlled-traffic tramlines
description:
Code, benchmark and per-run results for the article Drive around or cut holes? Obstacle-aware coverage paths and controlled-traffic tramlines for paddocks with scattered trees and rock outcrops.

The release extends the open-source coverage planner Fields2Cover (v2.1.1) with gate-anchored routing, an obstacle model for trees and rock outcrops, a curvature-bounded drive-around strategy, a straddle strategy for low obstacles, a raster section-control model and a controlled-traffic (CTF) tramline model. It contains the benchmark generator and runners, the per-run results of experiments E1 (855 layout-width cases), E2 (180 native Fields2Cover configurations), E3 (straddling low outcrops) and E4 (CTF tramline layouts), and the analysis scripts that regenerate every number, table and figure of the article.

The simulation experiments were run on the Nectar Research Cloud, supported by the NCRIS-funded Australian Research Data Commons (ARDC).
